## clean_names_lowercase function
```{r Load clean_names_lowercase function}
# Takes text and standardizes it, which we will need for merging later on:

clean_names_lowercase <- function(x) {

  x <- iconv(x, from = "", to = "UTF-8", sub = "")
  x <- stringi::stri_trans_general(x, "Latin-ASCII")

  x %>%
    tolower() %>%
    trimws()
}
```

## RAM Data
```{r Augment the RAM dataframe by collapsing all stock info into one score per genus per year}
colnames(RAM_Scores0)

RAM_Scores <- RAM_Scores0 %>%
  group_by(year, Genus) %>%
  summarize(
    RAM_BBmsy = mean(RAM_BBmsy_final, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_Formal_Assessments = sum(!is.na(RAM_BBmsy_numeric)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    RAM_provenance = case_when(
      n_Formal_Assessments == 0 ~ "value was interpolated based on formal assessment from other years (RAM or other*)",
      n_Formal_Assessments == 1 ~ "value was sourced from 1 formal assessment (RAM or other*)",
      n_Formal_Assessments >= 2 ~ "value was sourced from 2 or more formal assessments (RAM or other*)"
    )
  )
```

```{r Rename the Stock_Status column in Carta_Scores}
  mutate(
```

```{r Load in revised MajorGroup_KEY0}
  anti_join(
    MajorGroup_KEY_conflicts %>%
      select(
        estimated_genus_name

    by = c(
      "estimated_genus_name"
    )
  )
```

# ADD FOFM CORRECTION
```{r Assume 70% of all catch goes to Fish Oil Fish Meal}
FOFM_PROPORTION<- 0.70
NON_FOFM_PROPORTION<- 1 - FOFM_PROPORTION

colnames(Stock_Statuses)

Stock_Statuses <- Stock_Statuses %>%
  mutate(
    FOFM_weight_mt = if_else(
      coalesce(
        Major_Functional_Group == "Anchovy & Sardine (small pelagics)",
        FALSE
      ),
      total_weight_mt * FOFM_PROPORTION,
      0
    ),
    FIS_weight_mt = if_else(
      coalesce(
        Major_Functional_Group == "Anchovy & Sardine (small pelagics)",
        FALSE
      ),
      total_weight_mt * NON_FOFM_PROPORTION,
      total_weight_mt
    )
  ) %>%
  relocate(FOFM_weight_mt, FIS_weight_mt, .after = total_weight_mt)

# 13008 obs., 19 vars. (looks good!)

```

# **ASSUMPTION**: When stock status is missing one year but present previously, cary that value forward.
```{r When stock status is missing one year but present previously, cary that value forward.}
colnames(Stock_Statuses)

# Find the most recent non-missing stock status for each genus and region
Stock_Statuses_lookup <- Stock_Statuses %>%
  filter(!is.na(StockStatus_final)) %>%
  group_by(
    estimated_genus_name,
    OHI_region_est
  ) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = year, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(
    estimated_genus_name,
    OHI_region_est,
    StockStatus_final_lookup = StockStatus_final,
    StockStatus_source_lookup = StockStatus_source,
    StockStatus_source_year_lookup = year
  )

# Join lookup and fill missing statuses in all years
Stock_Statuses_final <- Stock_Statuses %>%
  mutate(StockStatus_year = NA_integer_) %>%
  group_by(
    estimated_genus_name,
    OHI_region_est
  ) %>%
  arrange(year, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    lookup_status = if_else(
      !is.na(StockStatus_final),
      as.character(StockStatus_final),
      NA_character_
    ),
    lookup_source = if_else(
      !is.na(StockStatus_final),
      as.character(StockStatus_source),
      NA_character_
    ),
    lookup_year = if_else(
      !is.na(StockStatus_final),
      as.integer(year),
      NA_integer_
    )
  ) %>%
  fill(lookup_status, lookup_source, lookup_year, .direction = "down") %>%
  mutate(
    fill_status = is.na(StockStatus_final) & !is.na(lookup_status),

    # Fill missing stock status and source
    StockStatus_final = if_else(
      fill_status,
      lookup_status,
      as.character(StockStatus_final)
    ),
    StockStatus_source = if_else(
      fill_status,
      lookup_source,
      as.character(StockStatus_source)
    ),

    # Assign source year
    StockStatus_year = coalesce(
      if_else(fill_status, lookup_year, NA_integer_),
      if_else(!is.na(StockStatus_final), as.integer(year), NA_integer_)
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-lookup_status, -lookup_source, -lookup_year, -fill_status) %>%
  ungroup()

dim(Stock_Statuses_final)
# 13008 obs., 23 vars.

# SANITY CHECK: Are most stock status estimates from 2018-2025 recent? Yes.
TEST<- Stock_Statuses_final %>%
  filter(year >= 2018, year <= 2025)

table(TEST$StockStatus_year)
```

# STEP 3: Calculate GEOMETRIC MEAN of stock landings * Stock_Status ------------------------------

```{r Load in this dataframe as needed}
Stock_Statuses_final<- read.csv("/home/ferrer/ohi_goc_prep/FP/v2026/FP_Scores_1.1/FIS_Scores_1.1/Stock_Statuses_Compiled_df_Oct282026.csv")
```


```{r Weights and geometric mean}
# Calculate the proportion of catch each "Stock" (i.e. genus) contributed to its regional total during the study period:
colnames(Stock_Statuses_final)

START_EVALUATION_PERIOD= 2018
END_EVALUATION_PERIOD= 2025

Stock_Weights_per.Region <- Stock_Statuses_final %>%
  filter(year >= START_EVALUATION_PERIOD & year <= END_EVALUATION_PERIOD) %>%
  group_by(estimated_genus_name, OHI_region_est) %>%
  
  mutate(StockCatch_mt = sum(FIS_weight_mt)) %>% # total tonnes across all years for each stock and region during the study period
  ungroup() %>%
  
  group_by(OHI_region_est) %>%
  mutate(TotalCatch_mt = sum(FIS_weight_mt, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% # total tonnes catch across all years and stocks for each region
  ungroup() %>%
  
  mutate(wprop_EVAL.PERIOD = StockCatch_mt / TotalCatch_mt) %>% # proportion of catch each stock contributed to the total catch
  distinct(estimated_genus_name, OHI_region_est, wprop_EVAL.PERIOD)

# NOTE TO SELF: see point about geometric weights. At present, the weights reflect the relative contribution per stock to total FOFM catch (per region) DURING the 2018–2025 period. Verify with Mel that this is correct. - EMF, Sep 5 2026.

# SANITY CHECK: Do the weights add up to 1?
TEST<- Stock_Weights_per.Region %>%
  group_by(OHI_region_est) %>%
  summarize(sum_w = sum(wprop_EVAL.PERIOD, na.rm= TRUE))
# Yup, looks good!
```

```{r Add weights data to Stock Status df}
colnames(Stock_Weights_per.Region)

Stock_Statuses_w_Weights <- left_join(Stock_Statuses_final, 
                                      Stock_Weights_per.Region, 
                                      by = c("OHI_region_est", "estimated_genus_name"))


# This is the geometric mean part:
FIS_Scores <- Stock_Statuses_w_Weights %>%
  group_by(OHI_region_est, year) %>%
  summarize(
    FIS_score = prod(StockStatus_final ^ wprop_EVAL.PERIOD, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    FIS_score = round(FIS_score, 2)
  )

dim(FIS_Scores)
# 265 obs., 3 vars.
```

# Closer look into what taxa are driving the scores:

```{r Whats happening in Region 1 lately?}
colnames(Stock_Statuses_final)

Region1_Look <- Stock_Statuses_final %>%
  filter(
    year >= START_EVALUATION_PERIOD,
    year <= END_EVALUATION_PERIOD,
    OHI_region_est == "region_1"
  ) %>%
  group_by(year, Major_Functional_Group) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_StockStatus = mean(StockStatus_final, na.rm = TRUE),

    mode_StockStatus_est.level = {
      x <- na.omit(StockStatus_source)
      if (length(x) == 0) {
        NA_character_
      } else {
        names(which.max(table(x)))
      }
    },

    .groups = "drop"
  )
# Looks like the change in small pelagics might be driving the changes, and those changes aren't only reflected in the CMSY.

ggplot(Region1_Look,
       aes(x = year,
           y = mean_StockStatus,
           color = mode_StockStatus_est.level,
           group = Major_Functional_Group)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  
  facet_wrap(~ Major_Functional_Group, scales = "free_y") +
  
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2)
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Mean Stock Status",
    color = "Average assessment level",
    title = "Region 1: Mean Stock Status through Time by Functional Group",
    subtitle = "Diagnosing decline in FIS"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

```

```{r Let's continue this close look}
Region1_CloserLook <- Stock_Statuses_final %>%
  filter(year>= START_EVALUATION_PERIOD & year<= END_EVALUATION_PERIOD, 
         OHI_region_est == "region_1",
         Major_Functional_Group == "Pelagic marine fish (excl. anchovy & sardine)") %>%
  group_by(year, estimated_genus_name) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_StockStatus = mean(StockStatus_final, na.rm = TRUE),
    mode_StockStatus_est.level =
      names(which.max(table(na.omit(StockStatus_source)))),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(Region1_CloserLook,
       aes(x = year,
           y = mean_StockStatus,
           color = mode_StockStatus_est.level,
           group = estimated_genus_name)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  
  facet_wrap(~ estimated_genus_name, scales = "free_y") +
  
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2)
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Mean Stock Status",
    color = "Average assessment level",
    title = "Region 1: Mean Stock Status through Time by Functional Group",
    subtitle = "Diagnosing decline in FIS"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```
